rules.statement: A notarial instrument can be modified by a subsequent non-notarially executed writing, provided that the latter does not itself require notarial execution.
rules.supporting_quote: "On this principle the receipt D 1 in the present case does not require notarial execution, inasmuch as it was not given 'for establishing any security, interest, or incumbrance affecting land,' or for any of the other purposes named in section 2. It is therefore admissible in evidence"
